design_notes: (a) domain error codes (LIFECYCLE_*, CONTEXT_POLICY_UNKNOWN, DELEGATION_TARGET_*, INSTANCE_ID_RESERVED, WORKSPACE_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN) are DISJOINT from the contracts v1 20-code TeamContractError vocabulary because isTeamContractError branches on code — contract-level failures (id parse, duplicate, session bound) surface as TeamContractError, domain-rule failures as typed domain errors
(b) every durable change bumps activityVersion by exactly 1, including setWorkspace no-op re-sets and clears — each is one durable record change (D3)

(c) MemberInstance wrapper {record, contextPolicy, hasEnteredRunning} owns the two invariants the v1 MemberInstanceRecordDto lacks (no contextPolicy field; §31 has-entered-running) — the v1 DTO gap is carried by the wrapper, not by patching contracts
(d) no per-template instance cap in T3 — quota is a separate concern (Arch §32, P3-T4)
(e) persistent delegation with ≥2 work-accepting instances refuses with DELEGATION_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS (candidateInstanceIds in details) rather than inventing a selection rule
(f) explicit address to ARCHIVED resolves 'continue' (the caller Restores per §30.2 before work); explicit address to DISPOSED is rejected (§29.5)

(g) operations enforce their own source lists — an operation must never alias another edge: RESTORE from RUNNING is rejected even though RUNNING→SETTLED is a legal pair (flaw found in D-03, regression-covered by the op-level sweep and property P2)
(h) the workspace mutation lock keys on durable hasEnteredRunning (for-life), not on the current lifecycle state (§31 lifecycle ≠ residency)
(i) t3-helpers.ts is a namespaced test helper beyond the strict t3-*.test.ts file glob — follows the endorsed contracts test/helpers.ts pattern; disclosed for reviewers

(j) the owned sub-package tsconfigs (lifecycle, member) extend the REPO-ROOT tsconfig.base.json (../../../tsconfig.base.json) — the P1-T4 skeleton shipped no sub-package example; this makes them run under the same strict config as the package tsc while avoiding the frozen package's rootDir/declaration pair
